name: MCAS Lab
description: MCAS Lab at the University of Seoul designs mixed-signal integrated circuits: data converters and the systems around them, from ultra-high-speed converters for communication links to low-power converters for biomedical sensing.
address: Room 305, Natural Science Building, 163 Seoulsiripdae-ro, Dongdaemun-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea
recruiting: 본 연구실에서 차세대 혼성 신호 회로 및 시스템 분야에 관심 있는 대학원생을 상시 모집합니다. 관심이 있거나 상담이 필요한 학생은 이메일 주시기 바랍니다.
heroLead: We design data converters and the mixed-signal integrated circuits around them, from ultra-high-speed converters for communication links to low-power converters for biomedical sensing.
recruitingEn: We are looking for graduate students interested in mixed-signal and data-converter circuit design. Please email Prof. Min-Jae Seo to talk about research topics and admission.
